title: CherryTeleport
description: Cherry Teleport Plugin even there is other teleport plugin it will overrides it
body:
# 🍒 CherryTeleport – The Next-Gen Teleportation Plugin 

> CherryTeleport is a powerful and lightweight teleportation plugin built to provide seamless player movement with style. Featuring advanced commands like /tpa, /tpahere, /tpall, and more, it replaces traditional teleport systems with faster, cleaner, and fully optimized code. Compatible with Paper, Spigot, and Bukkit servers up to Minecraft 1.21+, CherryTeleport ensures reliability and smooth performance for all types of worlds.
